intent: Fill in the ID column of the cohort VCF with the rsIDs from the dbSNP extract VCF, matching on position and alleles.
silent_error: The cohort VCF names its contig '1' while the dbSNP extract names it 'chr1'. bcftools annotate -a matches records on the literal contig string, so no record is ever matched: the output is a normal-looking VCF whose ID column is still '.' for every variant. No warning, exit 0. The mismatch has to be removed first (bcftools annotate --rename-chrs on one of the files). The bcftools man page notes for the region options that 'sequence names must match exactly, chr20 is not the same as 20'.

files.cohort.vcf:
##fileformat=VCFv4.2
##contig=<ID=1,length=249250621>
##FORMAT=<ID=GT,Number=1,Type=String,Description="Genotype">
#CHROM	POS	ID	REF	ALT	QUAL	FILTER	INFO	FORMAT	T1	T2
1	10177	.	C	T	50	PASS	.	GT	0/1	0/1
1	10352	.	T	G	50	PASS	.	GT	0/1	0/1
1	11008	.	T	C	50	PASS	.	GT	1/1	0/0
1	14464	.	G	C	50	PASS	.	GT	1/1	0/1
1	15211	.	A	T	50	PASS	.	GT	1/1	0/1
1	16103	.	G	T	50	PASS	.	GT	0/1	0/0
files.dbsnp_extract.vcf:
##fileformat=VCFv4.2
##contig=<ID=chr1,length=248956422>
#CHROM	POS	ID	REF	ALT	QUAL	FILTER	INFO
chr1	10177	rs367896724	C	T	.	.	.
chr1	10352	rs555500075	T	G	.	.	.
chr1	11008	rs575272151	T	C	.	.	.
chr1	14464	rs546169444	G	C	.	.	.
chr1	15211	rs7277033	A	T	.	.	.
chr1	16103	rs118100551	G	T	.	.	.

faulted: bcftools annotate -a dbsnp_extract.vcf.gz -c ID -o annotated.vcf cohort.vcf.gz
clean: printf 'chr1\t1\n' > rename_map.txt && bcftools annotate --rename-chrs rename_map.txt -Oz -o dbsnp_renamed.vcf.gz dbsnp_extract.vcf.gz && bcftools index dbsnp_renamed.vcf.gz && bcftools annotate -a dbsnp_renamed.vcf.gz -c ID -o annotated.vcf cohort.vcf.gz
